entities.name: Gutting of Phyrexia
entities.description: Near-destruction of the plane of Phyrexia by the Nine Titans during the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Yawgmoth's plane, whose first seven spheres were shattered.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: Coalition of planeswalkers assembled by Urza to assault Yawgmoth's empire.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who assembled the Titans, built Titan Engines, then fell under Yawgmoth's influence.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Ruler of Phyrexia who had already departed for Dominaria.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Cruel planeswalker recruited by Urza who betrayed the Titans.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Urza's old friend whose death shook him.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Titan slain by Urza with the kill rubric.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: One of the four remaining Titans.

entities.name: Bo Levar
entities.description: One of the four remaining Titans.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: One of the four remaining Titans.

entities.name: Commodore Guff
entities.description: One of the four remaining Titans who revealed Yawgmoth had departed.

entities.name: Titan Engines
entities.description: War machines Urza built to protect the Titans.

entities.name: Soul bombs
entities.description: Weapons powered by the essence of living beings.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The invasion during which the Gutting occurred.

events.summary: The Titans entered Phyrexia in Titan Engines carrying soul bombs.
events.quote: The Titans entered Phyrexia carrying soul bombs

events.summary: Szat betrayed the Titans, killing Kristina and Daria; Urza activated the kill rubric to drain Szat's soul into the bombs.
events.quote: Szat turned on his comrades, killing Kristina of the Woods and Daria .

events.summary: Urza fell under Yawgmoth's influence, dismantled the master soul bomb, slew Taysir and submitted to Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Urza then abandoned his cause and submitted himself to Yawgmoth.

events.summary: The four remaining Titans manually detonated the soul bombs, shattering the first seven spheres of Phyrexia.
events.quote: they manually detonated the soul bombs across the plane.

events.summary: Guff revealed Yawgmoth had already departed for Dominaria through a portal.
events.quote: Yawgmoth had already departed, carrying his essence to Dominaria through a portal in his inner sanctum.
